2017 Bespin Regionals TR - mingtown

  • Quote

    Post by mingtown » July 24th, 2017, 10:51 am

    Bespin Regionals was awesome! Props to Walseth for hosting and doing a great job as TD and to all my fellow Bespinites for showing up. I wish I could have made both events this weekend but had too much stuff going on on Sunday. I wasn't sure if I could remember enough about my games for this TR but I think I got most of it down correctly.

    Decks: stuck with good ol' TRM for LS. I won 2 games with this deck at Nationals, so I was pretty happy and comfortable with it. This deck ran the H1 package and minimal sabers (Luke's and Anakin's). For DS, I chose Coruscant CRv. This was a deck that a lot of the Pittsburgh crew played at Nats so I got to see it played a bunch of times and I lost to it each time. I made one small change to switch from Lord Vader to Choke Vader.

    Game 1: My TRM vs Cal's Hunt Down
    I actually forgot this game even happened, and Cal had to remind me at the bar after the tournament about how it went down. That jogged my memory and I think it went something like this: we both setup for the first few turns and both peel to Visage as Cal can't seem to find a Vader. I get Battle Plains out and stack a bunch of dudes there- Luke, Rey and Anakin I think. Cal gets Boba Fett in ship to space and someone to the flagship hallway. Also he topdecked his flagship bridge early on. So we trade drains for a few turns- he has to take at least 2 drains of 4 at the plains because I do not give him my Nar Shadaa so he can use Resistance. At some point I put Corran at the Holotheater to cancel Visage, but leave him there alone. Cal comes with Maul w/ Stick and I am holding a Nabrun in my hand with 3 force activated. For some reason I don't try and get him out of there and Cal battles. He draws high and I draw a 1, so I definitely could have afford the transport. Corran dies horribly and I get overflowed by 11. Ouch. But Cal still cannot use Resistance and a few more drains of 4 later his life force is drained. Great game, Cal. I was also reminded at the bar that I was the only player to beat him on the day so there's that too.
    FW

    Game 2: My Coruscant CRv vs Cory's OA
    Cory had just put this deck together the night before with no testing so I expected him to be a little rusty with it. My first turn I get Black 5 + DS-61-5 to Jakku so I can start tunneling for cards. Cory gets both his Jakku sites out and puts Solo in the Falcon but wisely decides not to take off. I get a look through my force pile to strengthen up space and get Baron + Saber 1 out to Jakku too. Cory gets Rey and Wedge RSL onto Jakku on his turn, sticks Harc Seff in the Falcon as passenger and takes off in front of my TIEs. On my turn he Antilles Maneuvers Chewie (V) into the Falcon. I forget who initiates the space battle, but I use Dark Maneuvers on Saber 1 and SRF combo to get a 15 attrition, killing everyone on the Falcon. I lose DS-61-5. Cory comes back with Home 1 + Ackbar and Hassn, and lands the Falcon. I get GMT (V) into Black 5 and there's another battle. This time I All Power along with all the other tricks, and clear Home 1. Here's the best part of this game though. I deploy Blizz 4 to the site adjacent to where Cory had the Falcon and Wedge's speeder, and Crash Landing the Falcon. Because the Falcon was crashed (with Rey and some other pilot aboard), it was no longer immune to trample. So I lumber over with Blizz 4 and trampled and POOPed it. Pretty awesome. Cory has trouble staying flipped, and deploys a second Home 1 but has no other pilots available. I have Dooku holed up in Rey's ATAT draining for 2. Time is called and we count up. I win by 2 in life force.
    TW

    2-0! I have never been 2-0 and it's getting to my head at this point.

    Game 3: My Coruscant CRv vs Adam's WHAP
    Adam loves WHAP, and he is good at it. But I know my strategy here is basically stack some DJs at the Throne Room to keep him from flipping, and silently pat myself on the back for putting in Choke Vaders. My opening hand though is garbage and the only dark jedi I come into is Sidious, who is not very useful in this application. So I have to draw while he moves towards the throne room. The best I could do was a Blizz 4 to get Vader but he is all the way out in the Courtyard and I have no hope of catching them at this point. He flips, and I try to clear some guys with a Maul w/ Stick, but he gets KYEO'ed. I try again with Dooku but the battle is canceled. Meanwhile in space I try to fight his Ric + ship and Bravo Fighter with Saber 1 and Black 5. I manage to clear him but I lose everything but Black 5. I went back with Boba and some other guy on Black 5, but it's too late as Adam gets the Spin AO out. I scoop and take the loss.
    FL

    Game 4: My TRM vs Adam's IE
    Adam again! I didn't expect to see so much IE in the meta but I suppose it was only the troopers version that got nerfed. Anyway, we do our setup for a few turns. Adam doesn't get that many sites out for a while. I stack up at Mos Eisley and he takes the other sites with some walkers and the Emperor. I deploy Nar Shadaa and get H1 there, but Adam comes at me with Flagship Executor and a whole buttload of dudes. But we realize that Nar Shadaa is far enough away from Tatooine that neither Executor can run away nor Devastator can come to its rescue. He starts a fight but H1 survives. I deploy Poe + GLiG1, Screaming Lando, Solo and Anakin to Nar Shadaa and start chipping away at his stack. Earlier in the game I grabbed Imperial Command and was a little unsure if it was the right move, but it was definitely the right move. Adam couldn't find his Imperial Justice, so after he spends his other 2 Commands keeping me to 1 destiny he couldn't stop me from drawing 4 or 5 BD. One battle I got up to 46 power and the Executor melted away in a few turns. I had enough guys at Mos Eisley too to keep the pressure up there. Eventually the drains were tilted in my favor and I won the game.
    FW

    Game 5: My TRM vs Bryan's IE
    I picked Bryan as a part of my fantasy Worlds team. He has been on a tear here in Bespin of late, winning ND states, going 6-0 at WI states, and would eventually win both Bespin Regionals and MN states. What I'm trying to say is that he is super good and I don't feel bad about losing this game. I did make a lot of mistakes though and got overflowed by 13 (left Anakin alone) and 9 in 2 battles at Tat sites. I did manage to clear the Devastator but my mistakes on the ground were too much to overcome. In retrospect I should have been able to put up a much better fight if I had gotten my maneuvering right. But alas I scoop with a half hour still to go.
    FL

    3-2 at this point. I'm finally able to eat my China Wok lunch. After all the other scores come in it looks like I actually have a chance at the Bye. Unbelievable! All I had to do was win my last game and hope for the best.

    Gmae 6: My Coruscant CRv vs Sam's Tatooine CPv
    Mains vs mains. Sam ran Luke Effect, IMBATS and H1 package. He gets the farm out and puts Owen and Beru there. Right away I should have played the retrieval shields but don't. He gets Shmi to the slave quarters and 3-PO, and puts the whole gang at the farm. On my turn I get Blizz 4 which pulls Vader aboard and Dooku to the farm, but for whatever reason I choose not to battle. I had a Trample AND force lightning in hand but elected not to battle. I could have caused some serious overflow but it was a total brain fart. On his turn Sam gets Luke + stick and Chewie + gun and he battles. I try to trample chewie but miss, but I'm able to choke him and fry Owen + Beru, but everyone dies except Vader. We fight hard for the farm for a few turns, trading mains until Sam saves up enough to deploy H1. I don't have my space interrupts handy so I had to deploy my ships to Kashyyyk instead. At some point Sam tracks a 7 and On the Edges for a 5 retrieval, and I'm kicking myself for not battling him in turn 2 that could have potentially cleared 3-PO. He starts chasing me around and deploys characters to my Coruscant sites and I can't really do anything to stop him and the game slips away from me. I scoop with 8 or 9 cards left. Well played, Sam!
    FL

    So I ended up 3-3 and finished in 6th place. But I think this is my best performance at any SWCCG event so far. We open our Theed packs and I'm hearing excited shouting all around me- Maul w/ Stick! Queen Amidala! I tear into my pack to find... Rolling, Rolling, Rolling. Oh well. Huge thanks to Walseth for these packs, I know he was holding onto this box for a very long time and it most likely will be the last packs to be given away for the foreseeable future. We go to the Crooked Pint for dinner and drinks and complain about fantasy football. The consensus was that Hunter Henry was the worst.

    Congrats to Bryan for sweeping the weekend. Looking forward to Worlds!

    2018 WI State Champ
    2019 MPC Consolation Top 4
